8 of 10 members present. Quorum established.

Agenda
Item 1
HRIS Platform Assessment — Vendor Selection Update

Madison Hoang summarized findings from the HRIS Platform Assessment — Vendor Selection Update review, covering the period ending 1986-02-16. The committee noted 101 employees affected across 2 locations in the Health Savings Account Administration sector. A motion was introduced following discussion. See motion record below. Exhibit A contains the full supporting analysis.

Motion

To approve: RESOLVED, that the Workforce Restructuring Committee approves the selection of Arken Benefits Partners as the vendor for the HRIS Platform Assessment — Vendor Selection Update and authorizes management to execute the final contract.

Moved: Desi Aquino  •  Seconded: Adefunke Wahyudi
Vote: 8 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 2
CEO Succession Plan Review — Emergency & Long-Term

The CEO Succession Plan Review — Emergency & Long-Term was a review of the company's compliance with international tax laws. The committee reviewed the company's international tax filings and confirmed that they were in compliance.

Item 3
Job Architecture Redesign — Phase 1 Approval

The Job Architecture Redesign — Phase 1 Approval was a review of the company's real estate portfolio. The committee approved a plan to consolidate 101 office locations, resulting in an estimated annual savings of $101M.

Motion

To approve for digitization: RESOLVED, that the Workforce Restructuring Committee authorizes ACPWB to proceed with the engagement described in the materials presented, subject to the terms and conditions set forth in the engagement letter dated 1986-02-16.

Moved: Desi Aquino  •  Seconded: Nour Girma
Vote: 5 Yea  /  2 Nay  /  1 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 4
Total Rewards Benchmarking — Peer Group Refresh

The regular quarterly review of the Total Rewards Benchmarking — Peer Group Refresh was led by Desi Aquino. The data presented in Exhibit D showed performance to be on track with the 1986 operating plan. The committee acknowledged the positive progress and accepted the report as filed, with no further action required at this time.

Item 5
DEI Metrics Dashboard — Q1 Progress Report

The DEI Metrics Dashboard — Q1 Progress Report was a review of the company's compliance with antitrust laws. The committee reviewed the company's competitive practices and confirmed that they were in compliance.

Motion

To conclude: RESOLVED, that the meeting be adjourned.

Moved: Nour Girma  •  Seconded: Adefunke Wahyudi
Vote: 6 Yea  /  1 Nay  /  1 Abstain  —  CARRIED
